doc.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Joining the musicians' union and hitting the road
summary: He joined the union at about fifteen but only got on the road at 19, unlike Stan Getz.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: And you joined the musician’s union when you were pretty young, right? DM About fifteen. The guys on the road, you know I heard Stan Getz left home to go with Jack Teagarden when he was 15. So it took me until 19 to get on the road. I was an old man.
